question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Conspiracy theories thrives on distrust of the government.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject **"Conspiracy theories" **is plural and should be followed by the plural verb **"thrive"** instead of **"thrives".**
 
• The correct phrase should be **"Conspiracy theories thrive on distrust of the government,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Conspiracy theories thrive** on distrust of the government."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "the government." **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
 
• **4: "on distrust of"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
